name: @wildflowerhealthio/smart-app-core
description: What a Wildflower connect menu offers, as pure data: the Official Wildflower Relay name entry (`relayServerUrlFor`, `RELAY_DOMAIN`), the server preset groups per connect target (`serverPresetGroupsFor`), what a relay or free entry names or why it names none (`serverUrlForRelayEntry`, `serverUrlForFreeEntry`), and the menu's copy (`MENU_COPY`, the relay group's heading, label, description and problem). Shared by `smart-app-react`'s `ConnectMenu` and the React-free server-docs console. No React, no DOM.
